center.$description: Center's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--center-<name>) on the page, a container or one Center, and every Center inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

max-width.$description: The widest the content gets when maxWidth isn't given (448px).

padding-x.$description: Side padding, outside the maximum width (16px).

padding-y.$description: Space above and below with vertical (32px).
